mechanics.claim: Basic attacks bounce to additional nearby enemies while the buff is active, dealing physical damage to them.
mechanics.quote: causing her basic attacks to bounce to additional surrounding enemies, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to them

mechanics.claim: If the triggering attack crits, the bounces also deal critical damage.
mechanics.quote: If the triggering attack critically strikes, the bounces will do so as well

mechanics.claim: Bounces occur only up to 8 times total per empowered attack sequence.
mechanics.quote: Bounces occur only up to 8 times and can target each enemy up to one additional time per empowered attack.

mechanics.claim: Ricochet resets Sivir's basic attack timer only if the buff was not already active; refreshing the buff grants no reset.
mechanics.quote: Sivir's attack timer will only reset from casting Ricochet if the ability's buff was not already active on her. Refreshing the buff will not grant an attack reset.

mechanics.claim: Ricochet deals reduced damage against minions and executes them below a health threshold.
mechanics.quote: Ricochet deals 65% damage against minions and executes them if they would be left below {{sti|{{as|15 health}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The buff lasts 4 seconds during which basic attacks are empowered.
mechanics.quote: empowers her crossblade for the next 4 seconds
